subject: Installing old packages on RStudio-hosted Shiny Server

messages.author: 6a1d61cf15ac5c37
messages.subject: Installing old packages on RStudio-hosted Shiny Server
parts:
Dear all,

I am trying to install several packages on the RStudio-hosted Shiny Server, but these packages run with at least R version 3.0.0. The solution suggested by Winston:

download.file('http://cran.rstudio.com/src/contrib/Archive/devtools/devtools_1.1.tar.gz',
  destfile='devtools_1.1.tar.gz')
install.packages('devtools_1.1.tar.gz', type='source', repos=NULL)
unlink('devtools_1.1.tar.gz')

does not work.

How could I improve this code in such a way that I am able to install the devtools package?

Thank you in advance!

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Installing old packages on RStudio-hosted Shiny Server
parts:
Sorry, we're probably going to be stuck on R 2.15.x on glimmer and spark. We'll probably be deprecating those servers as we're bringing up a new set of servers running on a totally different architecture that is more robust and isolated--every app will essentially be running in its own virtual server.

In the meantime, if your packages depend on R 3.0, then they simply won't work on glimmer and spark. Sorry.
